convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom 'CMO' indicator, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management. The CMO indicator logic is not available from built-in MT5 indicators, requiring manual Python reimplementation of both the CMO calculation and the trade execution wrappers.

derived_values.name: CMO buffer value at SignalBar and SignalBar+1

other_exits: Long position closed when CMO crosses below zero (Value[1]<0 and BuyPosClose=true)
Short position closed when CMO crosses above zero (Value[1]>0 and SellPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM<0 → fixed lot=abs(MM); MM>0 → deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: The entry logic checks two consecutive CMO bars: Value[1] (older bar, SignalBar+1) and Value[0] (newer bar, SignalBar). A buy signal fires when Value[1]>0 (older bar above zero) AND Value[0]<0 (newer bar below zero) — this is actually a crossunder from above, suggesting the signal naming in the code may be inverted or the intent is to enter on the first bar after a zero-line crossover. The SignalBar input (default=1) allows signal confirmation offset. The BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans act as gates controlled by input parameters. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose wrapper functions that handle order sending, position checking, and global variable management.
python_conversion_notes: 1) Must implement CMO (Chande Momentum Oscillator) indicator in Python: CMO = 100 * (Sum(Up) - Sum(Down)) / (Sum(Up) + Sum(Down)), then apply smoothing (SMA by default). 2) Must replicate TradeAlgorithms.mqh position management — check existing positions before opening, use global variable tracking for signal dedup. 3) Entry signal: CMO crosses zero line — long when CMO was above 0 on bar[SignalBar+1] and below 0 on bar[SignalBar] (note: verify crossover direction intent). 4) Position sizing: if MM<0 use abs(MM) as fixed lot; if MM>0 use as deposit fraction. 5) SL=1000 points, TP=2000 points applied on open. 6) Signal reversal closes opposite positions if enabled. 7) Deviation/slippage parameter=10 points.
